text_block_list.text:
Today, I was sorting fan letters with Yukino Bijin.
Thanks to her growing popularity, there's a massive mountain of them...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I end up rereading it over and over, and my hands just come to a complete stop...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I want a photobook of Yukino-chan!!"
"Are you going to do more fan events?"
"You're so cute, Daddy and I are going to watch your race!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Even little kids. There really are so many different kinds of fans.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: They all bring back so many memories... Everyone cheers in their own unique way, but I'm truly grateful for each and every voice.
choice_data_list: Ah, a new letter has arrived too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really? Ehehe... I'd love to read it!
choice_data_list: Let's take a short break, then.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um...? What's this...
"This is my first time writing to you"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We've really been gettin' more and more
new fans lately, so—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um...! This person has been... for a long time...
U-Um, I'll read it out loud!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...'I've been a fan of Yukino Bijin-san ever since she was running in the Morioka elementary school club.'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I had always cheered for you quietly until now, but seeing you become so wildly popular made me so happy that I just had to write this letter to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "You were undefeated back in elementary school, and look at how much you've grown! Even after moving to the Twinkle Series, you just keep evolving... I can't take my eyes off you!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "It gets a little lonely sometimes because you're so popular, but more than that, I'm just so happy to see you spread your wings on the big stage"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: I guess there are people like that too, huh.
I guess there really are people like that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes... um,
any kind of cheering makes me happy, but
even so... um...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Having someone who's always, consistently watching over you
is, well, kind of... like, you know...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Huh? That's weird...
Why am I...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very, very best!
So that I can show you an even better run...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "That's my way of answering the fans!"
